## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2023-05-26: S-1 files the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.2
- 2023-06-30: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed between GEN Restaurant Group, Inc., GEN Restaurant Companies, LLC, and the TRA Holders
- 2023-07-07: 8-K Item 1.01 filed with the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2

## Explanation

GEN Restaurant Group's TRA originated at its June 30, 2023 Up-C IPO, obligating the public company to pay 85% of net realized cash tax savings to the continuing GEN LLC Class B unitholders. Covered attributes are Section 754 basis step-ups from future redemptions or exchanges of Class B units, plus imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments themselves. The contract has not been amended or terminated. The recorded liability has grown modestly as exchanges have occurred: $0 at year-end 2023, $691k at year-end 2024, and $1.088M at year-end 2025 (carried at Q1 2026); no cash payments have been made. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
